build_PRXTransformer2DModel: build a PRXTransformer2DModel for text to image generation with configurable hidden size and attention heads
run_PRXTransformer2DModel_forward: run the PRXTransformer2DModel forward pass with latent image, timestep, and text conditioning tensors
create_img2seq_patches: create a sequence of non-overlapping image patches from a latent image tensor using img2seq
create_seq2img_reconstruct: reconstruct an image tensor from a patch sequence using seq2img with the original shape
build_PRXBlock: build a PRXBlock transformer block with cross-attention, modulation, and gated MLP for multimodal processing
